findings.claim: 10-K 指出 Scores 段主要對手為三大徵信機構與其合資的 VantageScore，後者在美國房貸市場的監管接受度提高。
findings.excerpt: VantageScore (a joint venture entity established by the three major U.S. consumer reporting agencies), which is selling a credit scoring product competitive with our products and which has experienced increased regulatory acceptance in the U.S. mortgage market.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：客戶可能以 AI 自建評分模型，且分析與決策產品愈來愈與大型語言模型開發商的產品競爭。
findings.excerpt: our analytics and decisioning products increasingly compete against products from large language model developers.

findings.claim: Motley Fool 報導 2026-09-29 FICO 股價單日跌 25.4%，文章稱政府與房貸業界正在扶植新競爭者 VantageScore。
findings.source: Motley Fool: Why Fair Isaac Corporation plunged today
findings.excerpt: Needless to say, when a company with a monopoly sees that monopoly erode, the stock can undergo a big rerating.
